# serverless-offline + AWS Api Gateway Lambda

For running locally, this project uses `serverless` to run a mocked API gateway locally, which is invoked through `start-server`. Start the server with `yarn start-server`

Run the client with `yarn start-client`

## Run locally with serverless & serverless-offline

`$ yarn install`
`$ yarn build`
`$ yarn start-server`
`$ yarn start-client`

## REST API & HTTP API

Run the client with `yarn start-client`

# @trpc/tests

This is the home for the entire test suite for `trpc`, including `@trpc/server`, `@trpc/client`, `@trpc/react-query` & `@trpc/next`.

This is an example to test that declaration files work with a big router in tRPC.

It has a `postinstall`-script that generates 1400 procedures (which you can modify in `scripts/codegen.ts`).

```bash
git clone git@github.com:trpc/examples-v10-next-big-router.git
cd examples-v10-next-big-router
yarn && code . && yarn dev
```

# SSG E2E Test

This example shows how you can prefetch queries. This page works without JavaScript enabled.

## In your Chrome DevTools

1. Press `CMD + SHIFT + P` to open the command palette.
2. Search for `Disable JavaScript` and press enter.
3. Reload page and see the data is still fetched.

name: 'Pull Request Labeler'
on:
  - pull_request_target

jobs:
  triage:
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/labeler@v4
        with:
          repo-token: '${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}'

# https://stackoverflow.com/q/70664840/590396
name: Dependabot auto-approve
on: pull_request_target

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  dependabot:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ github.actor == 'dependabot[bot]' || github.actor == 'renovate[bot]' }}
    steps:
      - name: Approve a PR
        run: gh pr review --approve "$PR_URL"
        env:
          PR_URL: ${{github.event.pull_request.html_url}}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{secrets.TRPC_GITHUB_TOKEN}}

      - name: Enable auto-merge for Dependabot PRs
        run: gh pr merge --auto --squash "$PR_URL"
        env:
          PR_URL: ${{github.event.pull_request.html_url}}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{secrets.TRPC_GITHUB_TOKEN}}

# Copied from `vercel/next.js` and tweaked.

name: 'Lock Issues & PRs'

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    # This runs 4 times a day:
    # https://crontab.guru/#0_0,12_*_*_*
    - cron: '0 0,6,12,18 * * *'

permissions:
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  group: lock-threads

jobs:
  action:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: dessant/lock-threads@v4
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          issue-inactive-days: 14
          pr-inactive-days: 30
          log-output: true
          # issue-comment: 'This issue has been locked because it had no new activity for 14 days. If you are running into a similar issue, please create a new issue. Thank you.'
          # pr-comment: 'This pull request has been locked because it had no new activity for 30 days. If you think, this PR is still necessary, create a new one with the same branch. Thank you.'
